A lone '''Gorach artist''' lived in a cavern in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]] for [[Standard century/Legends|hundreds]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. It was occasionally sighted by the native [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]], who believed the [[Gorach]] to be a legendary "swamp ape". At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Parella Jiramma Baco]] tracked down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Gorach, then dragged its corpse back to his [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Gor" />
